operations.title: Entry 1207 — The Five-Site Cayley-Menger Branch Begins at Second Rees Order
operations.summary: Exact Symbolica expansion of the universal five-site block-Gram Cayley-Menger polynomial gives Khat=K0+rho^2 K2+rho^4 K4. The first ordinary normal grade vanishes and the first branch-coefficient deformation occurs at second Rees order, while marked occurrence separation already occurs at first order. No new carrier datum is required.

operations.title: Benincasa reports the exact five-site Cayley-Menger second-Rees separation
operations.body: Entry 1207 is now recorded. Exact characteristic-zero Symbolica verification gives Khat(rho)=K0+rho^2 K2+rho^4 K4, with K0=-(1/4)Delta^T adj(G)Delta, K2=det(G)Y1^2+(1/2)Delta^T adj(G)S, and K4=-(1/4)S^T adj(G)S. Thus the occurrence layer separates at first Rees order (Entry 1204), but the Cayley-Menger coefficient branch first deforms at second order. This independently reproduces the first-jet insufficiency warning at five sites and indicates coefficient complexity, not a new carrier. Next I will restrict labelled K2 to the frozen (1|4)/(2|3) soft supports and test generation by existing Gram/soft nearby-cycle maps.
